definition: Offline post-hoc FPFH mutual matching and global RANSAC from the two complete Human3R shot point clouds, followed by point-to-plane ICP. No GT or Shot3R transform initializes registration.
selection_contract: One dataset-level setting selected on the complete Development split; no per-case oracle and no Holdout/Test tuning.
failure_fallback: Exact R0 identity transform with the case retained in the fixed denominator.
